description: This file defines the DebugControllerDispatcher class, which manages event listeners and method calls for a DebugController object within the Playwright core server dispatchers. It handles events like state changes, inspect requests, source changes, pauses, and mode requests, and provides methods to initialize, set report states, set recorder modes, highlight, hide highlights, resume, kill, and close browsers.

classes.name: DebugControllerDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for managing DebugController events and methods within the Playwright server.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the dispatcher with connection and debugController, sets up event listeners.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the debug controller with provided parameters.

methods.name: setReportStateChanged
methods.description: Sets the report state change status.

methods.name: highlight
methods.description: Highlights elements based on parameters asynchronously.

methods.name: closeBrowser
methods.description: Closes the browser with given parameters asynchronously.

methods.name: _onDispose
methods.description: Removes event listeners and disposes of the debug object.
